Genre: "Cinematic hip hop, Detroit rap, conscious rap, emo rap" Instruments: "aggressive piano stabs, layered orchestral strings, dark boom bap drums, vinyl crackle, tight percussive hats, pitch-shifted Eminem-style vocal" Tags: "82 BPM; brooding; tense; storytelling; modular sections"

[Verse 1 | relentless flow | syncopated rhyme stacks | dark orchestral backdrop]
Look, bottle on the nightstand, pills with a twist-off,  
Friends faded out — they blinked and then dipped off,  
Got my face in my hands, stainin’ these Polaroids,  
Remember that night? You crashed on my floor, annoyed,  
Phone blowin’ up, but I swipe that shit silent,  
Everybody gone, but the pain’s still vibrant,  
That’s my prize, huh? Live inside the migraine,  
My ex texted “you good?” — I typed “fine,” then lied, plain.  
No sleep in three days, eyes like a crime scene,  
Pulled the blinds tight, drift inside a pipe dream,  
You used to call me hero, now I’m some sideshow,  
Sayin’ “grow up,” yeah, well, shit, I tried though,  
Spent another night inhaling, staring at the kitchen light,  
Was I searching for forgiveness, or just another fix tonight?

[Hook | repetitive, cold, monotone chorus | layered backing vocals | minimalist piano motif | stuttered reverb]
And I can’t run,  
From all the shit I’ve done (can’t run, can’t run),  
Sick of waking up alone,  
One more friend gone (they’re gone, they’re gone),  
Yeah, it’s powder or hell,  
Both cut like a bell,  
Yeah, who the fuck am I  
When I can’t tell.

[Verse 2 | manic delivery | harsh enjambment | punchy rhyme pivots | eerie strings]
Shot glasses line up, yeah, medicine parade,  
Hoping I’ll evaporate if I keep the blinds drawn all day,  
All these little lies, spinning through a head full of static,  
You called me a habit, now you don’t pick up, that’s classic,  
Scrolling old pics, saw you with your new man,  
Swear my soul just kicked, I crushed the whole damn Xan,  
Laughed in the mirror — wait, fuck, that ain’t me,  
Eyes sunken, mouth dry, teeth feelin’ sandy,  
Used to have friends, yeah, ten on the speed dial,  
Now the numbers changed, voice mail’s the green mile,  
They say write a verse, get clean, shit’s a joke,  
Pen leaking powder, hands smell like smoke,  
I tried praying, tried waiting, tried trading one vice for the other,  
But every “sorry” just sounds faker, why bother?

[Bridge | tension build | distorted vocal | sharp snare fill | echo FX]
Sometimes I wish  
I could flip a switch,  
Erase that itch,  
Turn it all to static —  
But every memory sticks,  
Like scars I pick,  
Like your last text,  
Just two blue ticks.

[Hook | repetitive, cold, monotone chorus | layered backing vocals | minimalist piano motif | stuttered reverb]
And I can’t run,  
From all the shit I’ve done (can’t run, can’t run),  
Sick of waking up alone,  
One more friend gone (they’re gone, they’re gone),  
Yeah, it’s powder or hell,  
Both cut like a bell,  
Yeah, who the fuck am I  
When I can’t tell.

[Outro | hushed, confessional tone | stripped-down keys | distant room tone]
Photo in my pocket, corners bent, yeah, the crease faded,  
Counting all the things I lost, names I can’t say, they  
Say time’s a healer, but I’m still here waiting,  
If this is redemption, guess I’ll keep on faking.

[Intro | whispering vocal | sparse piano | faint vinyl hiss | slow build]
Another night, can't sleep, head stuck on rewind,  
Phone screen bright, every contact—ain't nobody replyin'.  
Cheap liquor, white dust—shit, that line look inviting,  
I'm talking to the ceiling, ain't nobody on my side and—  
(Breathing heavy) Man, why the fuck you hiding?  
Heaven's full, hell’s booked, they ain't letting me slide in.  
Same couch, same pill, same picture—she smiling,  
But I ain't seen that girl since the last time I tried this.  

[Verse 1 | intense storytelling rap | dry vocal upfront | aggressive hats]
Used to think I was slick—two-faced, playing both lanes,  
Sneakin' outta rehab, snortin’ snowflakes off my own pain,  
Look, that reflection's sick, man, you look like a cold case,  
Ex got a new man—he don’t even know her first name.  
Got real friends? Hell no—every call’s just a “Hold on,”  
Poured up, nose gone, coughing up these coupons,  
Doctors with the “move on,” mama’s just too strong,  
Papa got a new broad, step-sister moved out—gone.  
Why you gotta act hard, when the tears taste like napalm?  
Dial up my dealer, like, “Yo, you still got that napalm?”  
Hope in a baggie, yeah, faith in a damn palm,  
Only thing holy is the holes in these sweatpants, uh.  

[Chorus | repetitive, sing-rap hybrid | pitched-down double | detuned keys | layered harmonies]
[Chorus | pain-drunk hook | harmonized vocals | stuttering kick]
Don’t call me when you’re lonely,  
Don’t text me when you’re high,  
All these memories—phoney,  
You ain’t here, so why’d you lie?  
(Why’d you lie?)  
Shit I did, can’t own it,  
She gone, don’t know why—  
Took my heart and she loaned it,  
I keep looking for the sky.  

[Verse 2 | more conversational flow | confessional tone | low-end 808s | chopped vocal doubles]
Room’s spinning, pill bottle's laughing,  
Truth’s missing, yeah, who am I asking?  
Ripped all the pictures, her eyes keep flashing,  
Text on the dresser, "Don’t call, don’t answer."  
Used to see heaven in the freckles on her shoulder,  
Now I see hell in the baggies in my folder.  
Thought I could quit, man, that’s a joke,  
Lines in the mirror like lines I just wrote.  
Sweat on my palms, scars on my arms,  
Friends at the bar, but they never alarmed,  
You see me in public, just pass with a nod,  
Can’t say you know me—you don’t know the half.  

[Bridge | muttered rap | stark minimal beat | glitched vocal FX]
Who you trying to save?  
(Who?)  
Why you looking my way?  
Nah, I ain't changing for shit,  
Hell, I ain’t slept in days.  
Forgive? That’s a stretch—  
Can’t pay what I can’t replace,  
Heaven, hell—same address,  
Either way, I never stayed.  

[Chorus | main hook repeat | pitched vocal | saturated 808 | stacked harmonies]
Don’t call me when you’re lonely,  
Don’t text me when you’re high,  
All these memories—phoney,  
You ain’t here, so why’d you lie?  
(Why’d you lie?)  
Shit I did, can’t own it,  
She gone, don’t know why—  
Took my heart and she loaned it,  
I keep looking for the sky.  

[Outro | distant, muttered rap | filtered piano | trailing delay]
Every friend’s just a photo, every fix just a loan,  
Hell if I know where I’m headed, I can’t even call home.  
Phone outta service, my hope on low,  
If I make it through the night, don’t let anybody know.

Eyes burnt red, last text still sittin’ on read  
Man, fuck it, ain’t slept—call it tryna forget  
Stackin’ dirty dishes, let the kitchen resemble my head  
Every friend’s a stranger, trust is currency spent  
You find your people, lose yourself, that’s just payin’ the rent  
She left her photo by the fridge, couldn’t toss it yet  
I keep it there, proof I meant it, can’t stomach what’s next  
Powder on the counter, lookin’ like it’s beggin’ to mend  
My shaky hands, memories in my stomach, beggin’ to vent

Both sound right, neither sticks, next day you’re sunk  
Hate what I became, can’t say I didn’t try

To that last message you sent  
But pride’s a bitch, huh,

I still see you

Spit in the mirror—nah, can’t say that, shit  
Look at the man I built and the boy I still carry as baggage  
Prescription bottles, lines of pills, swap ‘em out for a laugh  
Swear the devil wears a suit, calls my phone just to chat  
I talk to God in a parking lot, shoes full of regret  
Got no faith, but I’m prayin’ for a break from myself  
Cops knockin’—neighbors said I scream in my sleep  
Shit, I ain’t crazy, I’m just dying to eat

But I’m tired, man, fuck it, let’s light up and fade

It’s always you,

Heaven’s just a room,  
Hell’s these afternoons  
I still see you—  
I still see you

[Breakdown | rapid-fire, pitched up backing vox | filtered drum break]  
All my friends went missing, or maybe I vanished

But if there’s a God, I hope she understands it

[Chorus | final refrain | full band | overdriven vocal | heavy drums]  
It’s always you,  
Playin’ in my head like a broken tune  
Powder in my veins, I ain’t immune  
Heaven’s just a room,  
Hell’s these afternoons  
I still see you—  
I still see you  
It’s always you,

But I probably won’t  
Yeah, it’s always you
